description: Snake-case names Equoria does not own, so check-camelcase-naming.mjs never counts them (Equoria-pjvp8). Every entry needs a reason naming the outside owner. Postgres physical names (schema.prisma maps, migration identifiers) are exempt automatically.

Postgres constraint and index names (SQL layer kept snake_case by owner ruling)
Postgres database names used by the test lanes and preflight
Postgres database names used by the gate-lock sentinel
Postgres sequence names generated for serial columns (SQL layer)
